description: This is a Python source file defining a price comparison service module. It orchestrates store scraping (via web scraping and potentially LLM extraction), handles fallback mechanisms including mock data, and computes aggregated price statistics for game prices across different stores. It also provides the main entry point for the comparison flow, integrating multiple data sources and processing steps.

methods.name: PriceStats compute_price_stats(results: List[StoreResult])
methods.description: Computes aggregate price data such as lowest, highest, average prices, and the best deal store from a list of store results, ignoring debug or placeholder entries.

methods.name: bool _has_real_results(results: List[StoreResult])
methods.description: Checks if the results list contains at least one entry with a valid (non-None, >0) price.

methods.name: ComparePricesResponse compare_prices(query: str, category: str = "all")
methods.description: Main async function orchestrating the price comparison flow, including live scraping, fallback to LLM extraction, mock data, and computation of statistics. It is the entrypoint for price comparisons in the system.

ctags.name: compare_prices
ctags.pattern: /^async def compare_prices(query: str, category: str = "all") -> ComparePricesResponse:$/
